A [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] '''long-necked quadrupeds''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Buoyant]] by [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], visited Buoyant and, in order to strengthen their own connection to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], engaged in a [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] where they pursued a herd of the quadrupeds and [[Death/Legends|killed]] several of the animals.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
